claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings characterized as complementary modes (citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.85, sachverhalt cross-lingual 0.282, linear hybrid PASS adversarial at JP 0.61-0.67) but DO NOT surpass TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.78-0.79) on jurist preference. True OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Full 174k evaluation BLOCKED on corpus dependencies.
evidence_summary: All 22 evidence_refs verified. Citation heritage: dense AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74 at 21-22yr (137k-144k). Section cross-lingual: sachverhalt 0.282>0.2, dispositiv 0.150>0.1, erwaegungen 0.094<0.1 at 1K sample. Linear hybrids: PASS adversarial at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79. Negative results: center_projected FAILS jurist gate all scales (JP 0.05-0.43), true OOS ceiling ~0.53, v18 hierarchy negative (purity 0.65<0.7), bge_ corpus fails transfer (6-8/14 PASS). Blockers: no bger_ corpus 2000-2019, no bge_/bger_ mapping, missing 2022-2026 parquet, no 174k section extraction.
